model_choice: Standard Maximum Covering Location Problem (MCLP) with binary selection x and coverage indicator y. n~24 candidates -> 48 variables. Fits easily within 3,600 variable limit. Uses direct linear constraints for cardinality and coverage implication.

candidates.meaning: Candidate site ID (corresponds to a li center)

population.meaning: Population of the li corresponding to the candidate site

k.meaning: Number of charging stations to select

prep.notes: Extracted population data for Da'an District villages from the latest available period (115年12月), keeping total gender ('計'). Merged with administrative boundary data to obtain village centroids in TWD97 TM2 projection, then converted to WGS84 lat/lon. Population counts are total persons per village. k=3 is hardcoded per specification. All Da'an District villages are included as candidates.
